title: Abraham's Lineage to the Present Day (2026): Living Hashemites (Jordan), Alaouites (Morocco), Aga Khan V, Ethiopian Solomonids, Georgian Bagrationis, Exilarch/Rabbinic Davidic Lines & Modern Y-DNA Clades

nodes.name: Hasan ibn Ali → Hasan al-Muthanna → Abdallah al-Kamil → Musa al-Jawn → Idris
nodes.role: Early Hasanid Descendants of Prophet Muhammad & Fatimah
nodes.notes: Through Prophet Muhammad's daughter Fatimah & Ali ibn Abi Talib -> eldest grandson Imam Hasan ibn Ali -> Hasan al-Muthanna (married Fatimah bint al-Husayn, uniting BOTH grandsons of Muhammad!) -> Abdallah al-Kamil -> Musa al-Jawn -> Idris (father of Qatadah).

nodes.name: Qatadah ibn Idris (1st Qatadid Sharif of Mecca, 1201) → Abu Numayy I → Barakat I & II → Abu Numayy II → Dhawu Awn Clan
nodes.role: Unbroken Seven-Century Sharifian Rulers of Mecca (Banu Qatadah)
nodes.notes: Contemporaneously documented patrilineal sequence from Qatadah ibn Idris (Emir of Mecca, 1201-1220) through Ali al-Akbar, Abu Sa'd al-Hasan, Abu Numayy I, Rumaithah, Ajlan, Ali, Hasan, Barakat I, Muhammad, Barakat II, Abu Numayy II, Hasan, Abdullah, Hussein, Abdullah, Muhammad, Awn, Abd al-Mu'in, Muhammad & Ali Pasha!

nodes.name: Sharif Hussein bin Ali (King of Hejaz, 1854–1931) → King Abdullah I → King Talal → King Hussein of Jordan (1935–1999)
nodes.role: Founders of Modern Jordan, Iraq (Faisal I) & Syria
nodes.notes: Sharif Hussein bin Ali led the Great Arab Revolt (1916); his sons Faisal I (King of Iraq) and Abdullah I (Founder of Jordan, r. 1921-1951) established modern Hashemite monarchies -> King Talal -> King Hussein bin Talal (r. 1952-1999).

nodes.name: LIVING (2026): King Abdullah II of Jordan (b. 1962, 41st Gen) → Crown Prince Al-Hussein (b. 1994, 42nd Gen) → Princess Iman bint Al-Hussein (b. Aug 2024, 43rd Gen!)
nodes.era: 1962 – Present Day (2026 • Living Royal House of Jordan)
nodes.role: Living 41st–43rd Generation Direct Descendants of Prophet Muhammad (Hashemite Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Reigning Hashemite King Abdullah II bin Al-Hussein (acceded 1999) + Queen Rania -> Crown Prince Al-Hussein bin Abdullah II (b. 1994, + Princess Rajwa Al Saif) -> Princess Iman bint Al-Hussein (born August 3, 2024 — 43rd generation from Prophet Muhammad; alongside her aunt Princess Iman bint Abdullah, b. 1996, & Prince Hashem, b. 2005!).

nodes.name: LIVING (2026): Alaouite Dynasty of Morocco — Hassan al-Dakhil (13th c.) → Moulay Ali Cherif (1631) → Mohammed V → Hassan II → King Mohammed VI (b. 1963) → Crown Prince Moulay Hassan (b. 2003)
nodes.era: 1266 – Present Day (2026 • Living Royal House of Morocco)
nodes.role: Living Hasanid Dynasty Ruling Morocco (via Hasan al-Muthanna & Al-Nafs al-Zakiyya)
nodes.notes: Descended from Hasan al-Muthanna -> Muhammad al-Nafs al-Zakiyya -> Hassan al-Dakhil (migrated from Yanbu in Arabia to Tafilalt, Morocco in the 13th c.) -> Moulay Ali Cherif (1631) -> Moulay Ismail -> Mohammed V -> Hassan II -> reigning King Mohammed VI (b. 1963) & Crown Prince Moulay Hassan (b. 2003).

nodes.name: LIVING (2026): Nizari Ismaili Imamat — Husayn ibn Ali → Ja'far al-Sadiq → Fatimid Caliphs → Aga Khan IV (d. Feb 2025) → Aga Khan V (Prince Rahim al-Hussaini, b. 1971, 50th Imam!)
nodes.role: Living Husaynid Spiritual Imamat (Continuous Nass Succession to 2026)
nodes.notes: Traces continuous hereditary Imamat from Fatimah & Ali -> Imam Husayn -> Ali Zayn al-Abidin -> Muhammad al-Baqir -> Ja'far al-Sadiq -> Isma'il -> Fatimid Caliphs (Cairo) -> Alamut & Persian Imams -> Aga Khan I–IV -> Prince Rahim al-Hussaini (Aga Khan V, living, b. 1971, acceded Feb 2025 as 50th Imam!).

nodes.name: Solomonic Imperial Spine (1270–1540): Yekuno Amlak → Wedem Arad → Amda Seyon I → Newaya Krestos → Dawit I → Zara Yaqob → Ba'eda Maryam I → Naod → Dawit II (Lebna Dengel)
nodes.role: Medieval Golden Age of the Restored Solomonic Empire of Ethiopia
nodes.notes: Nine unbroken father-to-son emperors from Yekuno Amlak (1270) through scholar-emperor Zara Yaqob (1434-1468) down to Dawit II (Lebna Dengel, r. 1508-1540).

nodes.name: Shewan Solomonic Branch (1540–1930): Abeto Yaqob → Segwe Qal → Werede Qal → Libse Qal → Negasi Krestos (1682) → Sebaste → Abuye → Amha Iyesus → Asfa Wossen → Wossen Seged → Negus Sahle Selassie → Princess Tenagnework → Ras Makonnen
nodes.role: 14-Generation Shewan Bridge Connecting Lebna Dengel to Emperor Haile Selassie I
nodes.notes: Lebna Dengel's 4th son Abeto Yaqob settled in Menz (Shewa) -> Negasi Krestos founded the Kingdom of Shewa (c. 1682) -> King Sahle Selassie (1813-1847, grandfather of Emperor Menelik II & great-grandfather of Haile Selassie via Princess Tenagnework -> Ras Makonnen!).

nodes.name: LIVING (2026): Ethiopian Imperial House — Emperor Haile Selassie I (1892–1975) → Crown Prince Amha Selassie (1916–1997) → Prince Zera Yacob Amha Selassie (b. 1953) & Prince Ermias Sahle Selassie (b. 1960)
nodes.role: Living Heads of the Ethiopian Imperial House & Crown Council (225th Traditional Monarch Line)
nodes.notes: Emperor Haile Selassie I (Tafari Makonnen, r. 1930-1974) -> Crown Prince Asfaw Wossen (Amha Selassie) -> Prince Zera Yacob Amha Selassie (living, b. 1953, Head of the Imperial House of Ethiopia) alongside his cousin Prince Ermias Sahle Selassie (living, b. 1960, President of the Crown Council of Ethiopia).

nodes.name: Late Medieval Bagrationis (1213–1505): Queen Tamar → George IV & Queen Rusudan → Demetrius II → George V the Brilliant → David IX → Bagrat V → Constantine I → Alexander I the Great → Constantine II
nodes.role: Common Ancestors of All Modern Bagrationi Branches (Mukhrani, Kartli & Kakheti)
nodes.notes: George V the Brilliant freed Georgia from Mongol rule; Alexander I the Great (1412-1442) and Constantine II (1478-1505) were the last kings before the kingdom divided into Kartli/Mukhrani, Kakheti, and Imereti.

nodes.name: Mukhrani & Kakheti Royal Houses (1505–2008): Prince Bagrat I of Mukhrani → Vakhtang V & VI → Prince George Mukhrani; AND King Heraclius II (Erekle II, 1720–1798) → King George XII → Prince Nugzar Bagration-Gruzinsky
nodes.role: Senior Agnatic Mukhrani Branch & Last Reigning Kings of Kartli-Kakheti
nodes.notes: Bagrat I founded the senior male-line House of Mukhrani; King Heraclius II (Erekle II) & King George XII were the final reigning Georgian monarchs before Russian annexation in 1800, continuing through the Gruzinsky branch.

nodes.name: LIVING (2026): Prince David Bagration of Mukhrani (b. 1976) & Princess Ana Bagration-Gruzinsky (b. 1976) → Prince Giorgi Bagrationi (b. Sept 27, 2011!)
nodes.era: 1976 – Present Day (2026 • Living Royal House of Georgia)
nodes.role: 21st-Century Unification of Both Living Georgian Bagrationi Royal Lines
nodes.notes: Born in 2011 and baptized by Georgian Patriarch Ilia II, Prince Giorgi Bagrationi unites both historic surviving branches of the world's oldest Christian royal house (Mukhrani via father Prince David & Kakheti/Gruzinsky via mother Princess Ana)!

nodes.name: Babylonian Exilarchs (Resh Galuta): Huna I → Mar Ukba → Mar Zutra II → Bostanai ben Haninai (+ Sasanian Princess Izdundad!) → Hisdai → David ben Zakkai → Hezekiah Gaon (d. 1058)
nodes.era: c. 170-1058 CE (Seder Olam Zuta; Letter of Sherira Gaon; Talmud)
nodes.role: Recognized Patrilineal Davidic Heads of Babylonian Jewry (Intermarried with Sasanians!)
nodes.notes: The Babylonian Exilarchs (Resh Galuta) maintained a recognized Davidic succession via Zerubbabel under Parthian, Sasanian & Abbasid rule! Exilarch Bostanai (c. 618-670) married Sasanian Princess Izdundad (daughter of Shah Khosrow II!). After last Exilarch Hezekiah Gaon (d. 1058), surviving branches migrated to Spain and France.

nodes.name: Sephardic Exilarchic Line: Don Judah Abravanel → Don Isaac Abravanel (1437–1508) → Leone Ebreo → Living Abravanel & Ibn Daud Families (2026)
nodes.role: Documented Iberian-Sephardic Family Preserving Direct Exilarchic Davidic Tradition
nodes.notes: Don Isaac Abravanel (statesman, Torah commentator & Treasurer of Portugal and Spain before 1492) and his son Judah (philosopher Leone Ebreo) preserved one of the best-documented Iberian family pedigrees claiming descent from the Babylonian Exilarchs — with thousands of living Abravanel/Abarbanel descendants worldwide today!

nodes.name: LIVING (2026): Ashkenazi Davidic Rabbinic Trunk — Hillel the Elder → Johanan HaSandlar → Rashi (1040–1105) → Maharal of Prague (1525–1609) → Living Luria, Horowitz, Katzenellenbogen, Dayan, Charlap & Schneersohn Families
nodes.era: 1040 – Present Day (2026 • Living Rabbinic & Hasidic Dynasties)
nodes.role: Primary Ancestral Trunk of Living Ashkenazi & Hasidic Davidic Traditions (Note: Pre-Rashi Link Traditional)
nodes.notes: Historically proven lineages descend continuously from Rashi (Rabbi Shlomo Yitzchaki, Troyes, 1040-1105 -> daughters Yocheved, Miriam & Rachel -> Rabbeinu Tam) and the Maharal of Prague (1525-1609) into living families today (Katzenellenbogen, Luria, Horowitz, Shapiro, Treves, Charlap, Dayan [incl. Moshe Dayan], & Chabad-Lubavitch Schneersohns). Scholarly integrity note: modern genealogists (Avotaynu) note the pre-1040 bridge from Rashi/Maharal back to Hillel & King David is traditional rather than contemporaneously documented.

nodes.name: LIVING (2026) Y-DNA: Cohen Modal Haplotype (J1-Z18271 / P58) & Samaritan Kohanim — ~3,000-Year Iron Age Levantine Patrilineal Cluster
nodes.era: c. 1200 BCE – Present Day (2026 • Modern Population Genetics)
nodes.role: Scientific Biological Continuity of Living Jewish & Samaritan Priestly Families
nodes.notes: Over 46% of living Ashkenazi and Sephardic Kohanim (and Samaritan priestly lines) share an extended Y-chromosome signature on Haplogroup J1-P58 (specifically clade J-Z18271, TMRCA ~3,100 yrs ago) — directly matching the Iron Age Levantine timeframe of the Aaronite priesthood!

nodes.name: LIVING (2026) Y-DNA: Hashemite / Sharifian Genetic Clade (J1-L859 / FGC8703) — Shared Arabian Patrilineal Lineage Today
nodes.era: c. 500 CE – Present Day (2026 • Modern Genetic Genealogy)
nodes.role: Independent Living Hashemite, Hasanid & Husaynid Families Converging on Y-DNA J1-L859
nodes.notes: Modern whole-Y sequencing of geographically separated Ashraf/Sayyid families across Jordan, Hejaz, Iraq, Yemen & Morocco reveals a striking shared J1-P58 downstream clade (J1-L859 / FGC8703) coalescing ~1,400–1,600 years ago — providing independent genetic corroboration of medieval Quraysh/Hashemite patrilineal continuity!
